steps.speaker: Wild Voice
steps.content: Hahaha, she will never leave with you. This is what she truly wants, a desire that runs deep in her soul.

steps.speaker: Wild Voice
steps.content: Lowly creatures like human beings don't deserve the ultimate truth.

steps.speaker: Wild Voice
steps.content: That's why she is giving up her filthy, temporary human shell, to become part of something timeless, to become one with the ultimate truth.

steps.speaker: Wild Voice
steps.content: The ultimate truth, that's what her heart truly desires, not salvation, whatever that is.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You look down on us, you taunt us. Still, you covet her soul, the soul of a lowly human being; that's because you can see how pure her soul is.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <size=31>She's brave; she's confronted her fears and ignorance. Time and time again, she has overcome the impossible to get to your territory. She has given all that she's got to conquer the unknown, even her life. You have no right to belittle her heroic endeavor.</size>

steps.speaker: Wild Voice
steps.content: All souls lie bare under the light of the Illusory Moon! Only I understands her true desire!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You filthy thing, you have no right to talk about what any of us wants. You have no idea what a true scholar takes pride in.
She opens her eyes slowly.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: It's you...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm bringing you back. I am here to get the scholar Dreya back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's leave this place together.
Dreya still looks dazed, but she slowly raises her hand and gently rests it on your palm.
Light flows out of the place where her palm touches yours and drives off the shadows around you. You start losing consciousness, feeling as if you're parting ways with the world.

options: Dreya, is your mind still clear?

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: It is...
Consciousness is slipping away from her. You hold her hand tightly, reassuring your groggy mind that she is still there at your side. The two of you march ahead.
There's light ahead. That must be where the exit is. You want to take the scholar out of here. There are so many questions you want to ask her once you get out.
What era did you live in? Where do you come from?
Why is your name on the stele? What kind of language are those engraved words? What happened to the other people?
Why did that monster say to you? How did it seduce you? How did it torture you?
How long have you been trapped in the abyss? Why didn't your guide come to get you? Am I the one who failed you?
Have we really met before?
But you don't ask any of these questions.

options: ... Have you seen the long sought after stars?

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: Almost... there...

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: It was offered to me... but I turned it down... at the last minute...

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: ...Why? Why did I refuse the ultimate truth when it was right before me... I rejected it, and it trapped me in the darkness of ignorance...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What you were dealing with was an evil thing. If you had done what it told you to, you would be trapped forever. You're seeking the ultimate truth, because that's your calling, because you want it to be a badge of honor.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're in the vanguard of the human race's conquest of the unknown. You would never bow down to that evil thing. You're a proud scholar, and you saw through its ruse. That's why you've come back; you know there are other ways to gain knowledge.
She gives a gentle smile.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: But I always forget the way back.

options: It'll be alright, you'll always have "guide".

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: In this expedition, we all lost ourselves at some point, some to fear, some to desire, some to despair. It's you who guided us out of the mire over and over again...

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: Thank you for finding my name... I'm back, and it's all thanks to you, my dear guide...

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: But you... you don't belong here...

She releases your hand. You turn to look at her, and her eyes are clear for the first time since you met her. It seems that she's finally recognized you. But she is drifting away from you, or, rather, you are drifting away from the illusory realm.

steps.speaker: Savage Monster
steps.content: Ahhhhh!
The Illusory Moon is gone. Beams of red light burst forth from inside the DisSea monster's body.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: The monster... it has been restrained!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Is that light...?
The monster falls, smashing against the ground. It roars in the direction of the glamorous city. The FAC soldiers open fire to beat it off. Their bodies are wounded, but their spirits are high.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Attack! This is our chance. Repel it! Don't let it break through the Broken Frontline!

steps.speaker: Savage Monster
steps.content: Ahhhhh!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Get lost, monster of the Black Ring! Want to bring us down? Not one freaking chance!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Is it the shackles? But Chief is...

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: MBCC! Mark that monster! We will assist you in capturing it!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Copy that! Listen up, everybody, there might be a Sinner or a creature of the same class on the loose. Arrest Squad, head out and control it, but know your limits. Intelligence Squad, proceed and gather intelligence.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief will come back. When that day comes, we will be able to detain this Mania entity.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: You don't belong in this timeline. Still... I'm glad that I met you here...

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: Go back where you came from... my dear guide...

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: I hope... you can find your way back...
She stands motionless in the sea of blue crystal flowers, seeing you off, as she disintegrates and vanishes into thin air, leaving behind the solemn stele.

On April 30, N.F. 113, with the Mania entity subdued, the DisSea Black Ring became less active, and the Third Broken Frontline remained intact.
Since the Mania entity that came into existence because of the Illusory Moon resonated with the shackles, it is classified as a Sinner, coded S-087.
The MBCC conducted an investigation to confirm its identity. The answer was found in a classified document.

One of the profiles of the Expedition's members reads:
<color=#fb9259>Dreya</color>, postdoctoral fellow with the National Academy of Astrophysics of an unspecified country; area of research: the Perishing Star and its effects. She joined the Black Ring Expedition in 20 N.F., and made a great contribution to the effort with her boundless knowledge and tremendous willpower. In 21 N.F., she entered the DisSea dead zone voluntarily.
Shortly afterward, the team went radio silent.

In 23 N.F., when Keylan returned from the DisSea dead zone, it was confirmed that the rest of the team had perished, including Dreya.

Cause of death: disintegration of the mind and mutation of the body due to the effects of the Perishing Star, at the young age of 32.
